feature_semantics.origin_value: latest observed daily median at forecast origin
feature_semantics.lag_1_observation: previous observed daily median, not necessarily previous calendar day
feature_semantics.rolling_mean_7_observations: mean over seven observed daily medians through origin
feature_semantics.rolling_std_7_observations: population standard deviation over same seven values
feature_semantics.change_over_7_observations: origin minus seventh previous observed value

unit_status: source header reports meter; depth datum and sign convention unverified
missing_policy: no imputation; no missing date fill
deduplication: median within exact state/district/station/calendar date; all source IDs retained
